title: cleome bungei
intro: Cleome bungei, commonly known as Spurred Coral Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cleomaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cleome bungei include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
